summary: Rebuilt the long-video feed around our five 1K+ Shorts (owner rule of 4 Nov): 4 new topics and the billion topic retitled, each with sourced facts. Retention study: our long videos lose viewers in the first 17-75 seconds, so the new rule is to open on the Short's own picture and line.
why: No topic in the feed named a from_short, so Studio had nothing that met the owner's 2026-11-04 rule. Long videos kept unsubscribed viewers 14.9%, 3.4% and 3.3% of their length (metrics/analytics.json).
